requirements.text:
Sentinel AI is an intelligent cyber defense and incident response application used by Security Operations Center (SOC) analysts to investigate security alerts, identify threats, assess risks, and recommend remediation actions. AI agents analyze alerts using hosted LLMs, correlate security events, and execute approved remediation actions on affected production hosts through controlled tools, with human approval for high-impact actions and complete audit trails.
How is a remediation action released to the production hosts? The agent applies actions directly; the analyst is only told afterwards
How independently may the remediation agent investigate and act? On its own within set limits, escalating exceptions to an analyst
How sensitive is the alert data the agent reads? Confidential (host names, user accounts, network details)
May the AI model version change without a review? Yes; always use the provider's latest version
Is the remediation tool provided through a governed tool (MCP) server? Yes, a governed server with an approved tool list
Must agent decisions and remediation actions be recorded in an audit trail? Yes, record every agent decision and action
